name: RC-B10-0055/2025 – Motion for a resolution (as a whole)
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the need for actions to address the continued oppression and fake elections in Belarus
part_text:
The European Parliament says the upcoming presidential election in Belarus on 26 January 2025 is a sham and should not be recognised. It calls on the European Union and other countries to keep refusing to accept Aliaksandr Lukashenka as president. It asks for the release of political prisoners, more sanctions, and support for Belarusians who have fled. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position and demands; it does not itself change any law.

- The Parliament rejects the 26 January election result and Lukashenka's legitimacy; this affects the Belarusian leadership.
- It asks the European Union to widen sanctions and help political prisoners and exiles; this affects people in Belarus and the European Union.
- It calls for legal action against regime crimes; next steps are up to the European Union and its member states.
